narrative: notifications: a latency fault: the service itself is slow. notifications spends 4010 ms p95 inside itself (baseline 10 ms), excluding time waiting on downstream calls; callers see notifications responses at 3000 ms p95 (baseline 12 ms).

proposal.description: Fail over or scale notifications; add a timeout and circuit breaker in its callers so slowness stops propagating.
